reference_description: Close-up of a dropper bottle closure showing a large, soft dark-plum/mauve rubber pipette bulb with a rounded dome top and a wide skirt that flares over a tall, highly polished rose-gold metallic collar/cap. The bulb is prominent, occupying roughly half the visible height. The collar is cylindrical, wide, and reflective with a warm gold tone. No bottle body is visible.
output_description: Full-bottle synthetic render showing a rectangular flat-sided bottle body in off-white/cream. The closure consists of a small beige/tan stepped collar (two-tier cylindrical cap) surmounted by a small dark-plum flat-topped cylindrical rubber bulb. The bulb is disproportionately small, flat-topped rather than dome-shaped, and the collar is beige/tan with no metallic finish whatsoever.
top_component_observed_shape: Small flat-topped cylinder (dark plum) sitting on a two-step beige cylindrical collar

component_semantics.evidence: A dark plum element is present at the top suggesting a rubber bulb, but its shape is flat-cylindrical rather than the large rounded dome seen in the reference; it lacks the characteristic rounded top and wide flared skirt of the reference bulb

Reference collar is tall, wide, highly polished rose-gold metallic; generated collar is beige/tan matte with stepped profile — no metallic finish
Generated bulb height is approximately 20% of closure height vs ~55% in reference
Generated Image 2 is nearly identical to rejected Image 3; minimal or no improvement between iterations
Bottle body in generated render is rectangular/flat-sided; reference shows no body but implies a cylindrical or round-shouldered bottle
Color palette of collar is completely wrong (beige vs rose-gold)
